question: Mr. Wax starts from Point A and drives 14 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 9 km, turns right and drives 7 km. He then takes a left turn, drives 3 km, turns right and drives 11 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 15 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified)
solution:
**Given: **

Mr. Wax starts from Point A and drives 14 km towards the north.

He then takes a right turn, drives 9 km, turns right and drives 7 km.

He then takes a left turn, drives 3 km, turns right and drives 11 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 15 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/561d33cb92f7a731608d517738d058dec7a213726b1a2eeaeb886c2359c50862.png] 

Thus, he should drive 3 km to the east in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
